requirements.description: Compustat Industrial Annual/Research financial statements for total accruals, Jones predictors, ROA and performance matching.

required_coverage.population: Compustat firm-years from 1963–1999, grouped by two-digit SIC and fiscal year; include source years needed for one-year lags and matching.
required_coverage.detail: The source starts with 1962 source files and reports accrual observations in 1963–1999. Required components include current assets, cash, current liabilities, current debt, depreciation, assets, sales, receivables, net PPE, net income, fiscal year and historical SIC. The item extraction notes min cell size eight; source text says fewer than ten are excluded.
